description: Text or email a pickup order's customer, as the pickup monitor's message composer does. kind=custom sends your words verbatim: channel sms or email, body, and for email a subject. kind=ready_reminder resends the ready-for-pickup notification from the company's template (ready orders only; the channel follows the notification settings). The message leaves Spark the moment it is confirmed and cannot be recalled; the preview shows the exact recipient and text. Refused while the account is not live. Customer replies appear in get_pickup_order. Requires Write + pickup.execute; operator credentials only. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and idempotencyKey. In-app assistants get a confirm card.

body.description: custom: the message, sent exactly as written.

order.description: Pickup order id, order number or pickup code.
